messages.author: 56e294258fa8fca7
messages.subject: shinyapps and
parts:
Hello,

I use the following instructions to save data into a remote file.

csvFileName <- 'stat.csv'
write.table( x = statData , file = csvFileName , append = TRUE , sep = "," , col.names = NA , qmethod = "double" )

It works locally well (i.e. with runApp()) At the first session, the file is created and the session data are stored. The next session, the session data are appended. But on shinyapps.io it doesn't work ? The file creation and update don't work : after several sessions when I download the bundle nothing new appears.

In the same way, the following instruction works locally well but doesn't work on shinyapps.io where I've got an access denied error.
ftpUpload( what = csvFileName , to = uploadURL , userpwd = 'userId:userPwd' ) # uploadURL is the url where to upload

Does someone know how to fix it ?
Thank you in advance,
Stéfane

You have a few options: 1) you can choose to upgrade to a paid plan, or 2) wait until next month when your 25 hour limit resets. You can see more about the plans here: http://www.shinyapps.io/#pricing

Hope that helps,
-Andy
